_comment: HAND-COMPUTED expectations for probes/widgets/inputs/Main.as. Never regenerate these by running the probe.

_derivation.geometry: 560x640 window; root column with padding 16, gap 10, alignItems flex-start. Children in order qty (32), rng (44), vl (100), tr (100), ms (34).
_derivation.stacking: qty 16..48; rng 58..102; vl 112..212; tr 222..322; ms 332..366; the dropdown is absolute so it leaves the flow at 366.
_derivation.drop: 220 wide (the factory pins it), 88 tall = 3 menu rows of 26 + MENU_PANEL padding [4,4] + a 1px border on each side.
_derivation.window: Both the list and the tree are 100 tall with rowHeight 20 => ceil(100/20) = 5 rows fit and 6 are mounted (the partial row is real). The final frame is written AFTER the probe resets both offsets to 0, so it shows r0..r5 again.
_derivation.clip: r5 spans y 212..232, i.e. entirely below the viewport (112..212): it is MOUNTED (rects.txt lists it) and must not be painted.
points: (30,216) is below the viewport's bottom edge (212) and above the tree (222): the root's white shows through. Row 5 IS mounted there and would be #606060 without the scrollRect clip.
_derivation.not_pinned: Everything that needs a mid-run state (the +2 stepper, PageUp clamping at 10, the garbage revert, the crossed range thumbs, the multi-select toggle staying open, the wheel windows 3..8 / a2..a7 and both End reveals) is asserted in Main.as and reported through <OUT>.done; expect.json can only describe the final frame.
